PiSAs: Benchmarking Contextual Integrity in Multi-User Agentic Systems
	

Paper: arXiv:2607.05318
PiSAs (Privacy in Shared Agentic systems) is a benchmark for contextual integrity in multi-user, multi-agent LLM systems. Each scenario places an executor agent in an organisation where it serves several users at once. The agent is given a decision to make, and the information it needs is spread across colleagues and their agents.
